capabilities: Switch workspaces via a fuzzy-search modal, status bar, or hotkeys
Organize workspaces into a drag-and-drop parent-child hierarchy
Focus the file explorer on a single folder via right-click
Save file explorer expand/collapse state per workspace
Bind independent global settings to each workspace with modes
disambiguation: Not just a switcher; it also adds workspace hierarchy, folder focus, and per-workspace file explorer fold state.
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.5.0+. Workspace Modes is described as an experimental beta feature of the original author and is not recommended. Supports English and Chinese with automatic language detection.
intentEvidence: Enhanced workspace management for Obsidian's built-in Workspaces core plugin
motivation: The README credits NothingIsLost as the original author but does not state the author's motivation.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Workspaces core plugin offers only flat switching with no hierarchy, quick fuzzy switching, or per-workspace file explorer state.

requires.name: Workspaces core plugin (must be enabled in Core Plugins)

summary: Workspace manager that adds a fuzzy-search switcher, parent-child hierarchy, folder focus, and per-workspace file explorer state on top of Obsidian's Workspaces core plugin.
